CHIEF COMPLAINT
Abnormal lab finding - positive Lyme titer.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Michelle is a 31-year-old female who presents with a positive Lyme titer. Patient reports an insect bite approximately two weeks ago while hiking in the woods. Since that time, she has been experiencing fatigue, lack of energy, and swollen joints in her elbows with associated pain. She also reports body aches, nausea, and decreased appetite, tolerating mainly toast and crackers. Patient notes a bull's-eye rash on her abdomen. She denies high fevers. Regarding her diabetes, blood sugars have been running okay with some minor fluctuations but nothing significantly out of range.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient endorses nausea, joint pain, and body aches. She denies abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fever.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Type 2 diabetes mellitus
Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
Metformin for diabetes
Lisinopril 10 milligrams daily for hypertension

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient reports hiking in the woods a couple of weeks ago, which is believed to be the source of the insect bite. She is monitoring blood pressure at home and avoiding salty foods for hypertension management.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs: Normal, no fever
Heart and lungs: Normal
Skin: Bull's-eye rash on left abdomen, warm to palpation, non-tender, no evidence of cellulitis
Joints: Bilateral elbow joint swelling with pain to palpation
Remainder of exam: Normal

RESULTS
Lyme titer: Elevated
Complete metabolic panel and CBC: Normal, no elevated white blood cell count

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Newly diagnosed Lyme disease: Start doxycycline 100 milligrams twice daily for three weeks. Consult with infectious disease. Follow-up appointment in one week.
2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Order hemoglobin A1c to assess glycemic control and determine if any changes to metformin are needed.
3. Hypertension: Currently well controlled. Continue lisinopril 10 milligrams daily. Order lipid panel. Continue home blood pressure monitoring. Refill lisinopril prescription.
